headline: Premier League live updates: Arsenal defeat Chelsea in thrilling London derby
Arsenal come from behind to beat Chelsea and maintain perfect start in pulsating London derby
description: Arsenal needed to come from behind to win a breathless game 2-1 against Chelsea at the Emirates Stadium as Kai Havertz scored for the third time in the Premier League against his former club.

headline: Martin Ødegaard, Kai Havertz strikes give Arsenal statement London derby win over Chelsea
description: Arsenal came from behind to record a statement 2-1 win in a vintage London derby against Chelsea at the Emirates on Sunday.

headline: Another game, more dropped points: Are Man United still a work in progress?
description: Michael Carrick had his head in his hands: Manchester United are just three games into the Premier League season, but they've already dropped points twice.

headline: Michael Carrick: Man United draw to Everton 'feels like defeat'
description: Michael Carrick has said that Manchester United's 2-2 draw with Everton "feels like a defeat" after his team conceded a 96th-minute equaliser at Hill Dickinson Stadium.

headline: Carrick 'bitterly disappointed' with Man Utd's late Everton draw
